verdict.rationale: Antigravity is built around delegating tasks to autonomous agents that operate across editor, terminal, and browser, with subagents, scheduled tasks, and natural-language task delegation extensively documented; hands-on community reports (comm-1, comm-10) confirm the agent/CLI actually works for delegated tasks. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of delegation quality, and community evidence is mixed on reliability/bugs which caps quality below top marks.
